title: Newton's 3rd Law
plot_overview: An investigation into a double murder in 1999 draws unexpected people into a search for justice. As the case unfolds, intrigue and hidden secrets complicate their efforts to uncover what happened and understand how the people involved became connected to the investigation.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like mystery stories involving investigations, unexpected participants, and hidden secrets; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted plots or straightforward cases.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing mystery; justice-driven story; unexpected characters | Cons: secrets may confuse; potentially dark subject matter
